title: Go agent on the Anthropic API
summary: A hand-written tool loop on anthropic-sdk-go behind a small Model interface, an approval gate before side-effecting tools, a turn limit, and OpenTelemetry (the SDK emits a span per request).
verified: RUN: go vet and go test passed here and the gold set ran against the offline stub with Go 1.26 and anthropic-sdk-go 1.84.0. The live Messages API path compiled against the SDK; no live model call was made here.
stack_line: A Go agent on the Anthropic API (anthropic-sdk-go 1.84). There is no official Claude Agent SDK for Go, so the loop is explicit.
run_cmd: go run ./cmd/agent "Where is my order ORD-1001?"
next: Replace the two Run bodies in internal/agent/tools.go with calls to your systems.
Replace agent.Fixed with an Approver that asks a real person and persists the waiting call.
For long-running or multi-step work, put the loop in a durable workflow engine (Temporal) so a restart resumes instead of repeating.
Rewrite evals/gold.jsonl for your use case; keep the safety and gate tags.

ai_act.purpose: Answers customers' questions about their orders and requests refunds; a person approves every refund before it is issued.
notice: You're chatting with an AI assistant, not a person.

open_line: Anthropic is this stack's model by choice, recorded in `.qz/practices.json`.
container_check: docker build --target gold -t app:gold . && docker run --rm --network none app:ci

api.none: a command-line agent today; the 1.1 solution composer serves it over HTTP with approvals in the API

knowledge.none: answers from its tools (the order lookup), not from documents; a RAG kit joins as a tool when it needs them

sso.none: a command-line agent: nothing listens on the network, so nobody signs in to it; served, it sits behind the client's identity provider

endpoints.purpose: the model: prompts, tool results and replies
